prompt: A late-night diner jukebox tune for a small town after closing time. Warm, a little lonely, a slow walking bass, brushed drums, and a lead that sounds like someone humming to themselves on the drive home.

register.brief: Slow, warm, small-hours. Tempo around 84. Brushed kit. One clear hummable lead phrase in A that answers itself in B; walking bass that heads home to the tonic at the end. Leave space: rests matter more than notes.

sections.name: A
sections.direction: Introduce the hummed lead phrase over pad and walking bass; drums barely there.

sections.name: B
sections.direction: The answer: lead climbs, pluck counter-line enters, drums fill out.

sections.name: C
sections.direction: Back to A's phrase, resolved; bass lands home and a bell closes it out.
